4. GMP Quality Assurance & Schedule E(1) Mudabbar SOPs

Schedule T (AYUSH GMP) Release Controls

All finished batches must undergo release testing before leaving the quarantine hold: Assay testing by HPLC, Moisture content (Loss on Drying < 8.0%), Disintegration time for tablets (< 30 minutes), and Aerobic Microbial Plate Count (< 10^5 CFU/g).

Mudabbar (Purification) Certification for Schedule E(1) Herbs

Kuchla (Strychnos nux-vomica) and Suranjan (Colchicum autumnale) are subject to mandatory multi-stage purification protocols. Raw batches must be accompanied by an authenticated Mudabbar batch certificate showing alkaloid moderation prior to formulation into finished products.

Packaging & Shelf-Life Protocol

Finished products must be packaged into food-grade, induction-sealed HDPE containers or Alu-Alu cold form blisters with nitrogen purging where appropriate. Labeled shelf-life: 36 months under controlled ambient room temperature (20-25°C, RH < 60%).
